# Release control — FIXTURES ONLY

Not a real release record. These markers exist so the positive fixture can reach
PASS and exercise the content buckets; without a sidecar every fixture stalls on
the KRITE bucket and the validators under test never get a clean baseline to
prove themselves against.

The audit reads this sidecar for the whole fixtures directory.
